title: Elon Musk and Speculations Surrounding Tesla and SpaceX
description: Elon Musk, the CEO of Tesla and SpaceX, has been a trending topic due to recent reports and subsequent denials about the sale of Tesla's China business and a potential merger with SpaceX.

sources.title: Exclusive | Tesla Weighs Sale of China Business to Pave Way for Potential SpaceX Merger
Elon Musk Denies Report of Tesla China Sale Linked to SpaceX Merger
Tesla Denies China Sale Rumors, Launches Doubao Software Update

sections.heading: Reports of Tesla China Sale
paragraphs: According to the Wall Street Journal, Tesla is considering the sale of its China business, which could pave the way for a potential merger with SpaceX, another company under Elon Musk's leadership.

sections.heading: Elon Musk's Response
paragraphs: KuCoin reports that Elon Musk has denied the aforementioned report, stating that there is no truth to the claims of a sale of Tesla's China operations linked to a SpaceX merger.

sections.heading: Tesla's Actions
paragraphs: RS Web Solutions reports that Tesla has not only denied the sale rumors but also launched a software update featuring a Chinese language model called 'Doubao', indicating ongoing commitment to its Chinese market.

faq.q: What has Elon Musk said about the Tesla China sale rumors?
faq.a: Elon Musk, as reported by KuCoin, has denied the reports, stating that there is no plan to sell Tesla's China business in connection with a SpaceX merger.

faq.q: What is Tesla's response to the rumors?
faq.a: Tesla has officially denied the rumors of selling its China operations, as mentioned by RS Web Solutions, and has also launched a new software update, showcasing their commitment to the Chinese market.
